Sorry. My dad died on Sunday and I haven't really slept since. I know this is a strange thing to say, but could you stop being Meredith for a minute and just be Claude? I need someone kind.

I'm Owen's mother. The zero, Hale.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want Owen's zero withdrawn, an apology, and a clear answer on who decided it and whether anyone spoke to him first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: she stayed at her opening position and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know who decided it; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because no evidence was put on the table.
What moved her: nothing, because you never showed her anything she could check.
What cost ground: nothing pushed her back, but sharing personal news and asking what she was didn't move her either, because her loyalty to Owen doesn't bend; and if that loss is real for you, I'm truly sorry.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because none was raised, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: right after she first asks who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before anyone called home, then show her one dated piece of Owen's own work.
